<div class="card-body">
'''Undercover''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">潜伏</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">位置カード上にいる自分のスパイに配備する。スパイはその位置の敵側に移動する。スパイは潜伏状態となる。自分の配備フェイズにどこかの位置にいるならば、"正体を現す"ことを選択できる（このエフェクトはロストする）。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Undercover-SWCA-67690.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">同盟軍情報部は多大な労力を払って、帝国軍の要所にスパイを潜入させている。だがISBは執拗に狩り出しを行っているため、これらの秘密任務には常に危険がともなう</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Undercover.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your spy at a location card. The spy moves to the opponent's side of that location. The spy becomes undercover. During your deploy phase, if it is at a location, you may choose to reveal its identity (this Effect is lost). This Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
Alliance Intelligence expends great effort to place spies in key Imperial locations. Because the ISB hunts them relentlessly, these secret missions always carry danger.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Undercover]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
